en.answer: Even in that case, the targeted cards including that face-down Defense Position card are destroyed and the Special Summon is performed.
en.question: If 1 of the 3 targeted "Igknight" cards is changed to face-down Defense Position as a result of <<5432>> being activated in a chain to the activation of the effect of <<11816>> or <<11817>> to Special Summon themselves, how does the Special Summoning resolve?

ja.answer: 手札にて発動する「<<11816>>」や「<<11817>>」の効果処理時に、対象の3枚のカードのうちの1枚となる「イグナイト」と名のついたモンスターが、裏側守備表示になっている場合でも、そのカードを含めた対象のカード3枚は破壊し、特殊召喚する処理を行います。
